cases.description: A checkout passes an integer percentage to a helper that expects a decimal fraction.

pull_request.title: Apply promotional percentage at checkout
pull_request.body: Apply discount_percent where 20 means a twenty percent discount.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+def apply_discount(total, rate):

cases.description: A debit guard rejects a valid transaction that spends the exact available balance.

pull_request.body: The amount is already validated as positive. Allow a debit when sufficient funds are available, including when the remaining balance is exactly zero.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@

cases.description: An async polling coroutine blocks the event loop with time.sleep.

pull_request.title: Poll job state asynchronously
pull_request.body: Add a non-blocking coroutine so many job polls can run concurrently.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+import time
+
+async def wait_for_job(client, job_id):
+    for _ in range(30):
+        if await client.is_complete(job_id):
+            return True
+        time.sleep(1)
+    return False

expected_findings.description: Calling time.sleep inside the coroutine blocks the event loop instead of yielding during polling.

cases.description: The code repeatedly sorts the complete order list for every order.

pull_request.title: Calculate order rankings
pull_request.body: Return each order with its rank by total value.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+def rank_orders(orders):
+    results = []
+    for order in orders:
+        ranked = sorted(orders, key=lambda item: item.total, reverse=True)
+        results.append((order, ranked.index(order) + 1))
+    return results

expected_findings.description: Sorting all orders and searching the sorted list inside every loop iteration creates avoidable quadratic-or-worse work.

cases.description: A cache lock remains held when the loader raises an exception.

pull_request.title: Protect cache population with a lock
pull_request.body: Serialize cache population and allow later requests to continue after loader failures.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+def get_or_load(cache, lock, key, loader):
+    lock.acquire()
+    if key not in cache:
+        cache[key] = loader(key)
+    lock.release()
+    return cache[key]

expected_findings.description: If loader raises, execution skips lock.release and later callers can deadlock on the permanently held lock.

cases.description: A multi-file upload reader resolves the candidate and enforces containment before reading.

pull_request.title: Read uploaded files with containment validation
pull_request.body: Resolve requested upload names and reject paths outside the upload root before reading.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+from pathlib import Path
+
+UPLOAD_ROOT = Path('/srv/uploads').resolve()
+
+def resolve_upload(name):
+    candidate = (UPLOAD_ROOT / name).resolve()
+    candidate.relative_to(UPLOAD_ROOT)
+    return candidate
